purpose: Record the intended Catalyst function boundary and safe legacy decommission order without publishing private runtime identifiers or configuration.

topology_decision.reason: Form intake, authorization proof, raw Retell webhooks, retry execution, and paid CRM/Billing mutation have different callers, credentials, runtimes, and failure blast radii. Combining them would reduce the function count while weakening least privilege and making rollback harder.

functions.security_boundary: Only administrator issue and authenticated Zoho Forms prefill calls; Lead-scoped read/update credentials and the assisted-session table remain outside authorization, call, and Billing runtimes.
Owns expiring access, email-only proof, bound prefill, and idempotent authorization submission. It cannot approve go-live, assign a test number, or create Billing state.
Only raw-body Retell inbound/events and private readiness routes; Development-only Data Store and Mail access.
Separate least-privilege retry trigger without the Retell webhook key, number resolver key, readiness token, routes, or HTTP host.
Billing and CRM write authority must never enter the free-test call runtime.
A direct Advanced I/O URL remains an ingress surface even when API Gateway is disabled.

functions.replacement: retell_free_test plus separately approved relationship and route controls
functions.security_boundary: Superseded approval behavior must not remain independently callable or bypass the canonical deployment gate.
A second event receiver would split idempotency and tenant ownership across incompatible stores.
A legacy processor must not consume or mutate canonical four-table state.

functions.replacement: deterministic client-scoped Catalyst JSON and CSV reporting
functions.security_boundary: Analytics is derived reporting and must not become transactional authority or a free-test launch dependency.

decommission_sequence.action: Read back canonical Retell inbound and post-call webhook bindings, confirm Catalyst API Gateway is disabled, and retain the canonical retry Cron disabled.
Confirm there are no clients, customer routes, or Production changes and record the owner's Development-only destructive cleanup authorization.
Permanently remove the seven disabled Analytics Crons and the obsolete AnalyticsSync and RetellProcessing Job pools, then independently read back the remaining Cron and pool inventory.

Delete retell_events, retell_inbound_resolver, retell_route_approval_control, process_retell_events, and analytics_sync through the Catalyst console because the approved connector has no function-deletion operation.
Independently read back function absence while retaining retell_free_test, retell_free_test_retry, crm_billing_orchestrator, FreeTestRetryDevelopment, FreeTestRetry1m, and RetellProbes.
Deploy revenue_leak_test_request_form and revenue_leak_test_setup_form into the Retell Development project only through a reviewed source-upload capability.
Resolve the mismatched legacy and target Form Data Store rows with an explicit preserve-or-discard disposition, then intentionally retire the old Forms callers.
Delete the two legacy Forms projects only after target function deployment and row disposition; keep Client Portal separate and Production untouched.

rollback_policy.containment: Stop synthetic deployment rows, unbind Development Retell routes, keep notification mode dry_run, keep Crons disabled, and preserve durable evidence.
rollback_policy.code_rollback: Redeploy a previously reviewed canonical package and independently repeat source, route, readiness, and synthetic lifecycle readback.

private_evidence_required_before_decommi: function-specific configuration inventory by variable name only
disable or removal result and independent absence readback
